summary: A dated entry ticket for Casa Batlló in central Barcelona, sold through Tiqets with an audio guide and the Gaudí Cube included, in four ticket tiers.
body:
## What this ticket is

Casa Batlló is one of the best-known buildings by Antoni Gaudí, on Passeig de Gràcia in the middle of Barcelona. This listing is an entry ticket sold through Tiqets, the booking platform, for the venue operated by CASA BATLLÓ, S.L.U. Tiqets states that it acts as the contact on behalf of the supplier, so questions about an order go to the Tiqets Help Center rather than to the building.

## What the listing says is included

Three things are named as included: the entry ticket itself, an audio guide, and access to the Gaudí Cube, which the listing describes as a 360º experience. The page does not say how long a visit takes or which languages the audio guide offers, so check those details in the checkout before you commit to a time slot.

## Four ticket tiers

After you choose a date, the checkout offers four options, named by colour: Standard (Blue), Upgraded (Silver), Premium (Gold) and All-Inclusive (Platinum). The listing gives the names but not a side-by-side comparison, so open each tier at checkout and compare what it adds and what it costs before choosing. The price shown on the listing the day it was read started at €29.00, and the final amount depends on the tier and the date.

## Opening hours

The listing shows the same hours for every day of the week, from 9:00 AM to 10:30 PM. Entry is booked for a chosen date, so the practical question is which time slot is left rather than which day is open.

## Changing your plans

The listing says free cancellation options are available and that rescheduling options are available. These depend on the ticket you select, so read the terms shown for your tier at checkout. If your plans are uncertain, choose a ticket whose terms you have read and understood.

## Is it right for you?

This ticket suits a visitor who wants to go inside a Gaudí house and prefers to fix the date in advance instead of queueing on the day. If you want a guided tour with a person rather than an audio guide, look at the other Barcelona listings on this site.
